exceptions.rationale: GitHub keeps this advisory reviewed and high with no patched release. Every affected package is dev-only (picomatch, fdir, tinyglobby, vite, vitest), the production-only audit is clean, the built bundle contains no picomatch, and repository glob inputs do not contain the vulnerable single-branch extglob shape. No untrusted runtime input reaches glob compilation. The exception covers only this advisory and expires for re-review.
